content: {"summary":"Customers report that official boarding times are shifted without announcements, causing frustration and empty apologies. [#tk_2830322] They also experience long waits at gates, sometimes 90 minutes, before being asked to leave due to fueling or maintenance issues. [#tk_2813093] Additionally, flights are delayed by several hours, with pilots or backup crews missing, leaving passengers stranded overnight. [#tk_2813057]"}
